name: Cinderheart Citadel
difficulty_label: Hard • lava castle, three minibosses and an awakening below the throne
description: Cross the heat-scarred bridges of a volcanic castle and its alchemical laboratories. Heat fields scorch nearby explorers; shallow pools ignite you and deep lava rivers are fatal. Break three wardens, dethrone Castellan Varr, then survive what wakes beneath his throne.
